fact: The remaining victims in the soil begin to groan and croak in horrible unison.

subject: infected victims vocalization

fact: Thorin recognizes the same musical quality he had sensed in Yrberop's mind, confirming the connection between the infected myconids and whatever waited ahead.

fact: A parade of vaguely humanoid creatures with decaying flesh covered in luminescent lichen and tumescent growths is seen through the mist.
source_quote: the party saw a parade of vaguely humanoid creatures, their decaying flesh covered in luminescent lichen and tumescent growths
subject: procession creatures

fact: The voices of the procession creatures stab into the party's minds with equal parts madness and glee.

fact: The chant states that Araumycos and Zuggtmoy will become one till death do part.
source_quote: Araumycos and Zuggtmoy joined together heart to heart, becoming one till death do part
